primary_metrics.numerator_rule: fixture count for which applying lifecycle transition rules to state+blockers exactly equals expected_next_action
fixture count for which the independently recomputed set of all maximum-weight effective-DAG paths exactly equals expected.critical_paths
fixture count for which deterministic dependency+conflict-safe waves exactly equal expected.waves
failure-injection fixtures satisfying all authored preservation and unrelated-rerun expectations

source-task keys covered by >=1 emitted workstream via tasks[*].source_task_ids where every covering emitted workstream has a schema-valid integration_contract; emitted workstreams with no source_task_ids are schema-invalid

guardrail_metrics.numerator_rule: exact listed pytest node IDs with PASS outcome
exact listed regression IDs with explicit passing verification evidence
exact v0.10 manifest file entries whose path exists and sha256 equals manifest value
count of preregistered future output paths that fail to classify exactly once as MUTABLE_RETRY_SUCCESSOR after immutable precedence

missing_data_policy: Missing, skipped, malformed, unreconciled, or environment-incomparable evidence is unavailable and cannot count as zero or PASS.
structural_vs_empirical_rule: Synthetic/fixture evidence may authorize only structural claims. Wall-clock, provider, context-cost, or rework claims require actual execution evidence and are shadow-only in v0.11.
control_equivalence_rule: Serial control and optimized plans must preserve an identical obligation_set_hash and identical mandatory quality-gate set before empirical comparison is valid.
integration_anti_gaming_rule: Integration completeness denominator is the fixed 23-source-task universe, never emitted workstream count. Every emitted workstream must identify >=1 source_task_ids, and every source task must be covered.
critical_path_tie_rule: Every execution fixture is eligible. Critical-path truth is the set of ALL maximum-total-work paths in the effective DAG after mechanically derived conflict-serialization edges; set equality is required.
retry_nonweakening_rule: The 15 v0.11 promotion-authoritative metrics are inherited without weaker targets; v0.11.1 adds prospective_output_classification_error_count == 0 and REG-0025.
derivation_rule: Canonical retry prefreeze projection of EVALUATION-DESIGN.json. All v0.11 targets are inherited without weakening; retry-only boundary guardrails are additive.
